items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: The owner, his name is Richie Gerber, he is Howard Stern’s cousin

ctx.x: Yeah. The owner, his name is Richie Gerber, he is Howard Stern’s cousin, whoop-de-do. He’s an amateur tenor player and always had an interest in music and started having music at this health food restaurant he had. Then he moved to a bigger location which was the big Bread of Life where they just had like a natural food supermarket, and in one little area where you could maybe eat some of the stuff you had just bought, they had a small stage and an upright piano. And it just made for a very strange scene…
You sound like a person who’s not totally happy with the way things are going. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -18-
